name: Lakshmir Bhandar Scheme
benefit:
- For women from Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribes households: ₹ 1,200/- per month
- For women from other category: ₹ 1,000/- per month.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a resident of West Bengal.
1. The applicant should be a woman.
1. The age of the applicant should be between 25 - 60 years.
1. The household of the applicant should be enrolled under the "Swasthyasathi" scheme.
1. The applicant should not be a government employee in permanent employment/ retired government employee of Central/ State Government, Statutory Bodies, Government Undertakings, Panchayats, Municipal Corporations/ Municipalities, Local Bodies, teaching and non-teaching employees of Government aided Educational Institutions, etc. receiving regular salary/ pension.
